title: Medieval History: Delhi Sultanate (Past Year Questions)

questions.q_en: Diwan-i Kohi was the department of________ introduced by Muhammad Bin Tughlaq.
questions.solution_en:
Diwan-i-Kohi (also Diwan-i-Amir-Kohi) was a department of agriculture established by Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq of the Delhi Sultanate. Its primary objective was to bring uncultivated land under cultivation by providing loans (sondhar) and other forms of assistance to farmers, and to improve agricultural practices.

Explanation of Other Options:

• military: The military department was typically Diwan-i-Arz.

• market: Alauddin Khalji is particularly known for his extensive market control policies and related departments (e.g., Diwan-i-Riyasat).

• charity: The department dealing with charity or religious endowments was often Diwan-i-Khairat or Diwan-i-Risalat.

Further insights:

• Muhammad bin Tughlaq initiated several ambitious and often controversial administrative and economic experiments.

• The Diwan-i-Kohi was part of his efforts to increase agricultural production and revenue. However, the scheme faced challenges due to corruption, inefficient implementation, and unfavorable climatic conditions, and ultimately did not achieve its intended success on a large scale.
questions.solution_hi:
दीवान-ए-कोही (जिसे दीवान-ए-अमीर-कोही भी कहा जाता है) दिल्ली सल्तनत के सुल्तान मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक द्वारा स्थापित कृषि विभाग था। इसका प्राथमिक उद्देश्य किसानों को ऋण (सोंधर) व अन्य सहायता देकर बंजर भूमि को खेती योग्य बनाना और कृषि पद्धतियों में सुधार करना था।

अन्य विकल्पों की व्याख्या:

• सैन्य: सैन्य विभाग दीवान-ए-आरिज़ कहलाता था।

questions.q_en: Which Delhi Sultan introduced two coins, namely silver tanka and copper jital?
questions.solution_en:
Sultan Iltutmish (1211 - 1236 AD) of the Delhi Sultanate introduced the silver tanka and copper jital as standardized currency.

· Silver tanka → Became the foundation of medieval Indian currency.

· Copper jital → Used for smaller transactions.

He also introduced the Iqta system and was the first Delhi Sultan to get recognition from the Abbasid Caliphate.
questions.solution_hi:
दिल्ली सल्तनत के सुल्तान इल्तुतमिश (1211-1236 ई.) ने चाँदी का टंका व ताँबे का जीतल मानकीकृत मुद्रा के रूप में शुरू किया।

• चाँदी का टंका → मध्यकालीन भारतीय मुद्रा का आधार बना।

• ताँबे का जीतल → छोटे लेनदेन हेतु उपयोग होता था।

उन्होंने इक्ता प्रणाली भी शुरू की और अब्बासी खलीफा से मान्यता प्राप्त करने वाले पहले दिल्ली सुल्तान थे।

questions.q_en: Who among the following Delhi Sultanate rulers took the policy of 'blood and iron' to deal with the Mewati community?
questions.solution_en:
• Ghiyasuddin Balban (ruled 1266 - 1287 AD) adopted a ruthless policy of "blood and iron" to crush rebellions and establish law and order, especially in regions like Mewat and Doab.

• The Mewatis were known for their rebellion and lawlessness, which Balban countered with strict military action and administrative control.

Ghiyasuddin Balban (Reign: 1266 - 1287)

Slave Dynasty (Mamluk Dynasty) - Delhi Sultanate

Early Life & Rise to Power

· Balban was a Turkic slave (originally from the Ilbari tribe) who was purchased by Iltutmish.

· He rose through the ranks due to his intelligence and loyalty, becoming a key noble during Nasiruddin Mahmud's reign (1246 - 1266).

· Served as Naib (deputy) and effectively controlled the Sultanate before formally ascending the throne in 1266 after Nasiruddin's death.

Key Policies & Reforms

Theory of Kingship (Divine Right & Blood Superiority)

o Balban believed in absolute monarchy and introduced the "Sijda" (prostration) and "Paibos" (kissing the Sultan's feet) to elevate his status.

o Declared himself the "Shadow of God on Earth" (Zill-e-Ilahi) to strengthen his authority.

Strong Centralized Rule

o Crushed the "Chahalgani" (Group of Forty) - a powerful council of nobles that challenged his authority.

o Appointed spies to monitor nobles and eliminated rebellions ruthlessly.

Further information:

Qutubuddin Aibak (Reign: 1206 - 1210)

· Founder of the Slave Dynasty (Mamluk Dynasty) and the Delhi Sultanate.

· Originally a Turkic slave of Muhammad Ghori, he rose to power as his trusted general.

· After Ghori's death (1206), Aibak declared himself the ruler of Delhi.

· Known for his generosity (called "Lakh Baksh" - giver of lakhs).

· Began the construction of the Qutub Minar (completed by Iltutmish).

· Died in 1210 while playing chaugan (polo).

Iltutmish (Reign: 1211 - 1236)

· Son-in-law and successor of Aibak, considered the real consolidator of the Delhi Sultanate.

· Fought rivals like Tajuddin Yildiz and Nasiruddin Qabacha to secure his throne.

· Introduced the "Iqta system" (land revenue system).

· Issued the silver Tanka and copper Jital - standardized currency.

· Completed the Qutub Minar.

· Nominated his daughter Razia Sultan as his successor, bypassing his sons.

Razia Sultan (Reign: 1236 - 1240)

· First and only woman ruler of the Delhi Sultanate.

· Faced opposition from nobles due to her gender.

· Promoted meritocracy, appointed an Abyssinian slave, Malik Yakut, as her close advisor.

· Overthrown by nobles led by Malik Altunia (later allied with her but both were killed).

· Her reign marked a brief but significant challenge to gender norms in medieval India.
questions.solution_hi:
• गयासुद्दीन बलबन (शासनकाल 1266-1287 ई.) ने विशेषकर मेवात व दोआब जैसे क्षेत्रों में विद्रोहों को कुचलने व कानून-व्यवस्था स्थापित करने हेतु "रक्त व लौह" (blood and iron) की क्रूर नीति अपनाई।

• मेवाती अपने विद्रोह व अराजकता के लिए जाने जाते थे, जिनका मुकाबला बलबन ने सख्त सैन्य कार्रवाई व प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण से किया।

गयासुद्दीन बलबन (शासनकाल: 1266-1287)

questions.q_en: Who among the following was daughter of Iltutmish, a ruler of Slave/Mamluk dynasty?
questions.solution_en: Razia Sultan, also known as Razia al-Din, was the daughter of Iltutmish, a ruler of the Slave/Mamluk dynasty in India. She became the Sultan of Delhi and the first female ruler of the Delhi Sultanate in the 13th century.
questions.solution_hi: रज़िया सुल्तान, जिन्हें रज़िया अल-दीन भी कहा जाता है, भारत में गुलाम/मामलुक वंश के शासक इल्तुतमिश की पुत्री थीं। वे दिल्ली की सुल्तान बनीं और 13वीं शताब्दी में दिल्ली सल्तनत की पहली महिला शासक थीं।

questions.q_en: In the Delhi Sultanate, which of the following were known as Bandagan?
options_en: Special person appointed for religious conversion.
Special officer for Land revenue recovery.
Specialized artisans employed in the royal kharkhanas.
Special slaves bought for military service.
questions.solution_en: In the Delhi Sultanate, "Bandagan" referred to special slaves who were acquired for military service. These highly trained slave soldiers played a pivotal role in the Sultanate's military strength and administration, serving as a loyal and effective fighting force under the rulers.
questions.solution_hi: दिल्ली सल्तनत में, "बंदगान" उन विशेष गुलामों को कहा जाता था जिन्हें सैन्य सेवा हेतु प्राप्त किया जाता था। ये उच्च प्रशिक्षित गुलाम सैनिक सल्तनत की सैन्य शक्ति व प्रशासन में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते थे, शासकों के अधीन एक वफादार व प्रभावी लड़ाकू सेना के रूप में सेवा करते थे।

questions.q_en: Which of the following Delhi Sultans primarily adopted a policy of consolidation rather than expansion?
questions.solution_en: Balban (1266-1287) was known for his strong administrative policies, maintaining law and order, and suppressing revolts rather than expanding the empire.
questions.solution_hi: बलबन (1266-1287) अपनी मजबूत प्रशासनिक नीतियों, कानून-व्यवस्था बनाए रखने व विस्तार के बजाय विद्रोहों को दबाने के लिए जाना जाता था।

questions.q_en: Diwan-i-Arz was essentially the department of _______ under Delhi Sultanate.
questions.solution_en: Diwan-i-Arz in the Delhi Sultanate was responsible for managing the military services affairs of the state. It played a crucial role in the administration of the army, including matters related to recruitment, salaries, and other military functions.
questions.solution_hi: दिल्ली सल्तनत में दीवान-ए-आरिज़ मूलतः राज्य के सैन्य सेवाओं के मामलों के प्रबंधन हेतु उत्तरदायी था। इसने सेना के प्रशासन में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई, जिसमें भर्ती, वेतन व अन्य सैन्य कार्यों से संबंधित मामले शामिल थे।

questions.q_en: Who among the following started the ceremony of 'Sijda' (prostration) and 'Paibos' (kissing of the monarch's feet), in the court?
questions.solution_en:
Ghiyasuddin Balban, who ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1266 to 1287, introduced rigorous court discipline and Persian court ceremonies like 'Sijda' (prostration before the sultan) and 'Paibos' (kissing the sultan's feet). These were aimed at enhancing the prestige and power of the monarchy and instilling a sense of awe and respect among the nobles and subjects.

Explanation of Other Options:

• Alauddin Khalji: Known for his military conquests and economic reforms, but Sijda and Paibos are primarily associated with Balban's efforts to assert royal authority.

• Iltutmish: An earlier Sultan of Delhi who consolidated the Sultanate, but these specific Persian court ceremonies are attributed to Balban.

• Muhammad bin Tughlaq: Known for his ambitious and often controversial experiments, but not specifically for introducing Sijda and Paibos.

Further insights:

• Balban believed in the theory of kingship that emphasized the divine right and despotic nature of the monarch.

• The introduction of Sijda and Paibos was part of his strategy to break the power of the Turkish nobles (Chahalgani or The Forty) and establish the supremacy of the Sultan.

• These practices were considered un-Islamic by some orthodox Ulema but were enforced by Balban to assert his authority.
questions.solution_hi: गयासुद्दीन बलबन, जिसने 1266 से 1287 तक दिल्ली सल्तनत पर शासन किया, ने दरबार में कठोर अनुशासन व फारसी दरबारी समारोह जैसे 'सिज्दा' (सुल्तान के सामने साष्टांग प्रणाम) व 'पाइबोस' (सुल्तान के पैर चूमना) शुरू किए। इनका उद्देश्य राजतंत्र की प्रतिष्ठा व शक्ति बढ़ाना तथा कुलीनों व प्रजा में विस्मय व सम्मान की भावना जगाना था।

questions.q_en: Which amongst the following Sultans shifted his capital from Delhi to Daulatabad?
questions.solution_en:
· Muhammad Bin Tughlaq (ruled 1325 - 1351) is known for his ambitious and often eccentric projects.

· In 1327, he decided to shift the capital from Delhi to Daulatabad (in present-day Maharashtra) to better control the Deccan region and to protect the empire from Mongol invasions.

· However, the move was a failure due to logistical issues, harsh travel conditions, and resistance from the people. Eventually, he had to shift the capital back to Delhi.
questions.solution_hi:
• मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक (शासनकाल 1325-1351) अपनी महत्वाकांक्षी व प्रायः विचित्र परियोजनाओं के लिए जाना जाता है।

• 1327 में, उसने दक्कन क्षेत्र पर बेहतर नियंत्रण व मंगोल आक्रमणों से साम्राज्य की रक्षा हेतु राजधानी दिल्ली से देवगिरी (वर्तमान महाराष्ट्र में) स्थानांतरित करने का निर्णय लिया।

• हालाँकि, रसद संबंधी समस्याओं व कठोर यात्रा स्थितियों के कारण यह कदम असफल रहा।

questions.q_en: Who founded the city of Agra?
questions.solution_en: Agra is believed to have existed since ancient times, including during the Mahabharata era. However, the city as we know it today was formally established by Sultan Sikandar Lodī, a Muslim ruler, in the year 1504.
questions.solution_hi: माना जाता है कि आगरा प्राचीन काल से, महाभारत युग सहित, अस्तित्व में है। हालाँकि, आज जो शहर हम जानते हैं, उसे औपचारिक रूप से मुस्लिम शासक सुल्तान सिकंदर लोदी ने वर्ष 1504 में स्थापित किया था।

questions.q_en: Who among the following sultans of the delhi sultanate appointed GhiyasuddinBalban as his/her prime minister?
questions.solution_en: GhiyasuddinBalban served under his sultan Nasir-ud-din Mahmud as his right hand for 20 years and crushed all the rebellions whether outside the court or inside the court. Following his master's death, Balban ascended the throne in February 1265 AD. He first executed the survivors of the Chalisa and relieved himself of the dangers of rivalry. He suppressed with an iron hand the hill men whose forays were a terror in the suburbs of Delhi.
questions.solution_hi: गयासुद्दीन बलबन ने अपने सुल्तान नासिरुद्दीन महमूद के अधीन 20 वर्षों तक उनके दाहिने हाथ के रूप में सेवा दी और दरबार के अंदर व बाहर सभी विद्रोहों को कुचला। अपने स्वामी की मृत्यु के बाद, बलबन फरवरी 1265 ई. में सिंहासन पर बैठा। उसने सबसे पहले चालीसा के जीवित सदस्यों को समाप्त किया और प्रतिद्वंद्विता के खतरों से खुद को मुक्त किया।

questions.q_en: Who composed Tabaqat-i-Nasiri in the Delhi Sultanate period?
questions.solution_en: Tabaqat-i-Nasiri named for Sultan Nasir-ud-Din, is an elaborate history of the Islamic world written in Persian by Minhaj-i-Siraj Juzjani and completed in 1260.
questions.solution_hi: तबकात-ए-नासिरी, जिसका नाम सुल्तान नासिरुद्दीन के नाम पर रखा गया, फारसी में मिनहाज-ए-सिराज जुज्जानी द्वारा लिखा गया इस्लामी विश्व का विस्तृत इतिहास है, जो 1260 में पूरा हुआ।

questions.q_en: Which officer under Alauddin Khilji was required to maintain a register of merchants to ensure an adequate supply of goods?
questions.solution_en: Alauddin Khilji set up three markets in Delhi. Each market was under the control of a high officer called 'Shahna' who maintained a register of the merchants and strictly controlled the shopkeepers and the prices.
questions.solution_hi: अलाउद्दीन खिलजी ने दिल्ली में तीन बाजार स्थापित किए। प्रत्येक बाजार 'शहना' नामक एक उच्च अधिकारी के नियंत्रण में था जो व्यापारियों का रजिस्टर रखता था और दुकानदारों व मूल्यों को सख्ती से नियंत्रित करता था।

questions.q_en: Who had assumed the title of Balban?
questions.solution_en: The Sultan Ulugh Khan-i-Azam, otherwise called Ghiyas-ad-din Balban, belonged to the stock of the Khakans of Albari. His father was khan over ten thousand houses (khanah), and the family was well known in Albari, among the Turkish tribes of Turkistan. Now, inasmuch as the Almighty desired to grant a support to the power of Islam and strength to the Mohammedan faith, to extend His glorious shadow over it, and to preserve Hindustan within the range of his favour and protection. He removed Ulugh Khan in his youth from Turkistan, separating him from his race and kindred, and from his tribe and relations, and conveying him to the country of Hindustan, for the purpose of curbing the Moghuls. God conducted him to Baghdad, and from that city to Gujarat, where Khwaja Jamal-ad-din Basri, a man remarkable for piety and integrity, ability and worth, purchased him and brought him up carefully like a son. Intelligence and ability shone out clearly in his countenance, and his patron, Jamal, looked upon him with an eye of kindness and treated him with especial consideration.
questions.solution_hi: सुल्तान उलुग खान-ए-आज़म, जिसे गयासुद्दीन बलबन भी कहा जाता है, अलबारी के खाकानों के वंश से संबंधित था। उसका पिता दस हजार घरों (खानाह) का खान था, और यह परिवार तुर्किस्तान के तुर्की कबीलों में अलबारी में प्रसिद्ध था।

questions.q_en: Which of the following systems of the Delhi sultanate had an influence on the Bahmani and Vijayanagar kingdoms?
questions.solution_en: The Iqtadari system of the Delhi Sultanate involved granting land revenue rights to individuals in exchange for military or administrative service. This system's influence extended to the Bahmani and Vijayanagara kingdoms in the Deccan region, where similar revenue arrangements were adopted.
questions.solution_hi: दिल्ली सल्तनत की इक्तादारी प्रणाली में सैन्य या प्रशासनिक सेवा के बदले व्यक्तियों को भूमि राजस्व अधिकार देना शामिल था। इस प्रणाली का प्रभाव दक्कन क्षेत्र में बहमनी व विजयनगर साम्राज्यों तक फैला, जहाँ इसी प्रकार की राजस्व व्यवस्था अपनाई गई।

questions.q_en: Who was the first sultan (in the recorded history of the Dargah Sharif) to visit the shrine of Khwaja Muinuddin Chisti?
questions.solution_en:
• Muhammad bin Tugluq was the first sultan( in the recorded history of Dargah Sharif) to visit the shrine of the Khwaja Muinuddin Chisti.

• Muhammad bin Tughluq (reigned 1325 - 1351) was the second Sultan of the Tughluq dynasty in India.

• Muhammad bin Tughluq is remembered as a ruler with grand visions but flawed execution.
questions.solution_hi:
• मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक ख्वाजा मोइनुद्दीन चिश्ती की दरगाह में जाने वाला (दरगाह शरीफ के दर्ज इतिहास में) पहला सुल्तान था।

• मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक (शासनकाल 1325-1351) भारत में तुगलक वंश का दूसरा सुल्तान था।

• मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक को भव्य दृष्टिकोण परंतु त्रुटिपूर्ण क्रियान्वयन वाले शासक के रूप में याद किया जाता है।

questions.q_en: Who introduced the system of Dagh and Huliyah and cash payment to soldiers in the Delhi sultanate?
questions.solution_en: Alauddin Khalji, the second ruler of the Khalji dynasty in the Delhi Sultanate, introduced the system of Dagh (branding) and Huliyah (uniform) for the soldiers to ensure loyalty and discipline in his army. He also initiated the practice of cash payments, replacing the traditional land grants, to maintain a centralized control over the military and reduce the risk of disloyalty.
questions.solution_hi: अलाउद्दीन खलजी, दिल्ली सल्तनत में खलजी वंश के दूसरे शासक, ने सेना में वफादारी व अनुशासन सुनिश्चित करने हेतु सैनिकों के लिए दाग (branding) व हुलिया (uniform description) प्रणाली शुरू की। उसने पारंपरिक भूमि अनुदानों के स्थान पर नकद भुगतान की प्रथा भी शुरू की, ताकि सेना पर केंद्रीकृत नियंत्रण बना रहे व अनिष्ठा का जोखिम कम हो।

questions.q_en: Which Sultan established a separate department (Diwan-i-AmirKohi) to take care of agriculture?
questions.solution_en:
Mohammad Bin Tughlaq (1325-51)

Prince Jauna, son of Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq ascended the throne in 1325.

· He gained the title Ulugh Khan. He was most educated of all the Sultans of the Delhi Sultanate.

· He created a department Diwan-e-Amir-e-Kohi for the improvement of the agriculture.

· He distributed Sondhar i.e. agriculture loans advanced for extension of agriculture in barren lands.

· He encouraged cash crops in place of cereals.
questions.solution_hi:
मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक (1325-51)

राजकुमार जौना, गयासुद्दीन तुगलक का पुत्र, 1325 में सिंहासन पर बैठा।

• उसने उलुग खान की उपाधि प्राप्त की। वह दिल्ली सल्तनत के सभी सुल्तानों में सबसे अधिक शिक्षित था।

• उसने कृषि सुधार हेतु दीवान-ए-अमीर-ए-कोही विभाग बनाया।

questions.q_en: Zafar khan was a famous General of which of the following rulers of the Delhi Sultanate?
questions.solution_en: Hizabruddin, better known by his title Zafar Khan, was a general of the Delhi Sultanate ruler Alauddin Khilji. He held charge of Multan, Samana, and Sivistan, Sindh at various times during Alauddin's reign.
questions.solution_hi: हिज़ब्रुद्दीन, जो अपनी उपाधि जफर खान के नाम से अधिक जाने जाते हैं, दिल्ली सल्तनत के शासक अलाउद्दीन खिलजी के सेनापति थे। अलाउद्दीन के शासनकाल में विभिन्न समय पर उन्होंने मुल्तान, समाना व सिविस्तान, सिंध का प्रभार संभाला।

questions.q_en: Raziya Sultan was the first and only female ruler of the Delhi Sultanate, who ascended the throne in:
questions.solution_en: Raziya Sultan was the first and only woman ruler of the Delhi Sultanate. She ascended the throne in 1236 AD after the death of her father, Iltutmish. However, her reign lasted only four years (1236-1240 AD) before she was overthrown by nobles who were against a woman ruling the empire.
questions.solution_hi: रज़िया सुल्तान दिल्ली सल्तनत की पहली व एकमात्र महिला शासक थीं। वे अपने पिता इल्तुतमिश की मृत्यु के बाद 1236 ई. में सिंहासन पर बैठीं। हालाँकि, उनका शासनकाल केवल चार वर्ष (1236-1240 ई.) ही चला, जिसके बाद उन कुलीनों द्वारा उन्हें अपदस्थ कर दिया गया जो एक महिला के शासन के विरुद्ध थे।
